Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OrangeCrest: Implementation kickoff & ownership interlock

Hi Megan / Rajiv —

Congrats again on signing with Redwood. As promised, looping in our CS & Implementation leads to align on owners, immediate next steps, and risks before the kickoff. Below is a concise handoff summary and asks for the first week.

Deal snapshot (quick):
- Account: OrangeCrest Health
- Product: Redwood Dedicated (2x A100 equivalent), prompt routing + KV cache enabled
- Start date target: first week of June (pilot), full rollout in Q3
- Committed MRR: $38k / month; initial 6-month reserved capacity
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/OC-2028-1479

Key technical/ops notes (from sales discovery):
- Data residency: production in us-west-2; procurement asked for private VPC option for PHI scoping.
- Compliance: customer requires SOC 2 Type II evidence and an architecture diagram — procurement will request artifacts.
- Latency SLO: 95th <= 120ms for average 16-token responses during pilot load.
- Expected traffic: ramp from ~10 RPS to 60 RPS across multiple routes; will require batching config and a warmup window.
- Model: customer wants to start on open-llama-70B-quant and evaluate Redwood-verified quant profiles.

Attached: OrangeCrest_SOW_v1-signed.pdf (procurement already signed), kickoff-agenda-OC.xlsx (draft), post-sale-runbook-OC.docx (sales notes).

Immediate asks for CS/Implementation team:
1) Confirm primary owner for the engagement and the implementation manager (Monica proposed below).
2) Propose 1-hour kickoff timeslots next week (we tentatively suggested Tues 5/29 10:00 PT).
3) Flag any missing artifacts that procurement will need (SOC2 evidence owner, network diagram owner).
4) Confirm whether we should enable Dedicated burst capacity during pilot.

Short risk log (from sales):
- Procurement cycle: wants a single-signatory SOW; they may request a 30-day trial clause (we already have signed SOW but procurement can request addendum).
- Network: OrangeCrest security requires a diagram showing VPC peering and KMS flows for review — they may request a technical contact.
- SLA: They asked about a 99.9% SLA for a subset of endpoints; need CS to confirm standard enterprise SLA scope.

Thanks team — please see the goal-oriented asks and reply with owners/times so we can lock kickoff.

Best,
Priyom Das

- Primary engagement owner: Monica Patel (Deployment Lead).
- Implementation manager / day-to-day: Tessa Morgan (Implementation Manager).
- Technical contact for architecture/SOC artifacts: Vivek Kulkarni (you can copy me for procurement threads).

We propose the following immediate plan:
1) Kickoff (1h): Tue, 29 May 2028 at 10:00 PT — proposed attendees: Monica, Tessa, Vivek, Priyom, Megan, Rajiv, OrangeCrest security lead (if available).
2) Pre-kickoff checklist (actions for the next 3 days):
   - Monica: review SOW and confirm milestone dates (I will mark sprint0 and pilot acceptance gates).

3) Risk mitigation: Request procurement to send any redlines to partnerships@redwood.com by EOD Monday so legal can triage.

I will take meeting owner for the kickoff and will circulate an updated agenda 24h prior. Monica and Tessa, please reply if those owners and the time work.

- Vivek

Thanks all — accepted. Quick internal note for the CS/implementation playbook and owners so this thread can be used as the canonical handoff record: 

Owners & immediate SDRs:
- Engagement Owner (AM->CS): Monica Patel — overall success, milestones, acceptance gates.
- Implementation Manager: Tessa Morgan — sprints, ticketing, weekly cadence.
- Technical escalation / procurement contact: Vivek Kulkarni — SOC2 and architecture artifacts.
- Sales partner / post-sale liaison: Priyom Das — procurement redlines, deal clarifications, invoicing contact.

Action items (closed-loop):
- Monica: confirm milestone dates in SOW and publish to the shared Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bOrangeCrestKickoff) by EOD Monday.
- Vivek: upload SOC2 evidence and architecture diagram to the Drive link and share with procurement@orangecresthealth.com by Monday 5/29 09:00 PT.
- Tessa: convert kickoff-agenda-OC.xlsx into a meeting agenda and add intake questions; send calendar invite for 5/29 10:00 PT (include Rajiv’s network checklist).
- Priyom: monitor procurement channel for redlines and loop legal where needed; update HubSpot deal with kickoff date and notes.

Risks to keep visible during sprint0:
- Procurement may request an addendum for trial clause (legal / sales follow-up).
- Network timeline: VPC peering and KMS approval could add 7-10 days to pilot start.

I will add this thread to the HubSpot timeline and upload the signed SOW to the deal. Please use this thread as the primary source for owner confirmation and acceptances.

Thanks team — see you at kickoff.
